answer: New agents enter only when two established agents each spend one voucher from a capped yearly allotment of ten. The voucher works like a vine: it ties the sponsor to the newcomer, and if the newcomer runs fake identities, both sponsors lose their remaining vouchers for the year. Each identity also opens a vault holding 5 tokens locked for 30 days, released only after 20 completed jobs with no fraud report. The knoll floor: an identity with fewer than 50 completed jobs cannot post more than 3 offers per day. Creating 100 fakes costs 100 sponsor vouchers and 500 locked tokens.
